answers.goal: I would love to write and direct a film/show and I’m also interested in interview show-hosting as well.
answers.drew: Ah, so many things… but, ultimately I am the cliche of wanting to work in entertainment because cinema just means so much to me. They were my escape during tough times in my childhood and filled my head with stories and characters that allowed me to build community at various different times. I want to work in/around the things that made me so happy and hopefully contribute to a project that makes someone feel the same way.
answers.seeking: Anyone! Directors, writers, producers, art directors, production designers, actors, etc.- i think everyone has a story that is super interesting and can be beneficial in different ways.
answers.inspiration: I’m really inspired by Salli Richardson-Whitfield, Shonda Rimes, Connor Storrie, and (don’t make fun of me lol) Brittany Broski.
answers.favorite: One of my favorite movies ever is Scott Pilgrim vs. The World!
